eventBoundary: Observer stores run-local display facts from existing wave/spawn/leak/recover/completion/end events only. It writes no persistent analytics and never invokes tracker.snapshot(). A fresh actual wave resumes observation after an ended Sandbox attempt. Completed counts prefer the union of unique recorded completion IDs from the UI facts and statistics; Game sequential round/end semantics are used only without either recorder. Final-wave captions do not imply skipped campaign waves were completed.
remainingRootIntegration: Root owns final native ended/review/offline/responsive verification and the final full suite.
